title: fix(skills): correct EVM compare gas headlines for null/zero chains
claim: evm_client.py `compare` must never name a chain whose eth_gasPrice fetch failed (gas_price_gwei=None) or a 0x0 (0.0 gwei) chain as most_expensive_gas; 0.0 is the real minimum and headlines come only from priced chains.

evidence.red: On main, new tests/skills/test_evm_skill.py: 2 failed. test_compare_headlines_ignore_chains_whose_gas_fetch_failed -> `AssertionError: assert 'ethereum' == 'bsc'` (failed-fetch chain named most_expensive_gas); test_compare_zero_gas_chain_is_cheapest_not_most_expensive -> `AssertionError: assert 'bsc' == 'ethereum'` (0.0-gwei chain not cheapest).
evidence.negative_control: (1) restore `key=lambda x: x.get('gas_price_gwei') or float('inf')` -> zero-gas test fails (`'bsc' == 'ethereum'`), failed-fetch test passes; (2) restore headlines from unfiltered list (`priced = sorted_by_gas`) -> failed-fetch test fails (`'ethereum' == 'bsc'`). Each test pins one half of the fix.
evidence.adjacent: tests/skills/test_optional_skill_scripts.py (5), test_optional_skill_self_paths.py (1), test_authoring_standards.py (1471) + new file: 1479 passed, 0 failed. ruff check, check-windows-footguns.py, git diff --check clean.
evidence.source: main optional-skills/blockchain/evm/scripts/evm_client.py:1009-1019 still uses `x.get("gas_price_gwei") or float("inf")` and sorted_by_gas[0]/[-1] headlines; _fetch_chain_stats:960-965 maps eth_gasPrice exceptions to gas_price_gwei=None. No change to this function since the fork merge-base (git log empty). SKILL.md:130 'Shows cheapest/most expensive chain'.

upstream_overlap: None owning the defect: GraphQL search (evm_client.py / evm compare / most_expensive_gas / cheapest_gas / gas_price_gwei) + cached-title grep found no PR/issue on cmd_compare headlines.
